title: Final Energies
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct expressions for the perturbation energies of the second and third lowest states in integral form.

title: State Classification
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly classify the three lowest-energy states in terms of their spatial and spin components.

title: Wave Function Forms
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly write the antisymmetrized and symmetrized wave functions for the two-particle system.

title: Perturbation Treatment
description: Important Criteria: The student should demonstrate understanding of treating the perturbation in a nondegenerate manner for the first excited state.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common mistakes such as incorrect normalization of wave functions or incorrect application of symmetry principles.
